user.title: Year Roundup
user.description: Start tracking your home's year. Long-term stats (energy, temperature) are backfilled; counters like door opens and top artists start from today. Optionally pick an AI Task entity to write the captions. If it is a cloud service, your roundup summary is sent to it.
